title: The Diatessaron (Section 43)
breadcrumbs: Home > Fathers of the Church > The Diatessaron (Tatian) > Section 43

paragraphs.text: 1 {{BIBLE:luk 12:41}} Simon Cephas said unto him, Our Lord, is it to us that you have spoken this 2 parable, or also to every man? Jesus said unto him, Who, do you think, is the servant, the master of the house, trusted with control, whom his lord set over his 3 household, to give them their food in its season? {{BIBLE:mat 24:46}} Blessed is that servant, whom his 4 lord shall come and find having done so. Verily I say unto you, He will set him 5 over all that he has. But if that evil servant say in his heart, My lord delays his 6 coming; {{BIBLE:mat 24:49}} and shall begin to beat his servants and the maidservants of his lord, and 7 shall begin to eat and to drink with the drunken; {{BIBLE:mat 24:50}} the lord of that servant shall come 8 in the day that he thinks not, and in the hour that he knows not, {{BIBLE:mat 24:51}} and shall [Arabic, p. 163] judge him, and appoint his portion with the hypocrites, {{BIBLE:luk 12:46}} and with those that are not faithful: {{BIBLE:mat 24:51}} there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

9 {{BIBLE:mat 25:1}} Then shall the kingdom of heaven be like ten virgins, those that took their 10 lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom and the bride. {{BIBLE:mat 25:2}} Five of them were 11 wise, and five foolish. {{BIBLE:mat 25:3}} And those foolish ones took their lamps, and took not with 12, 13 them oil: {{BIBLE:mat 25:4}} but those wise ones took oil in vessels along with their lamps. {{BIBLE:mat 25:5}} When then 14 the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept. {{BIBLE:mat 25:6}} But in the middle of the night there occurred a cry, Behold, the bridegroom comes! Go forth therefore to 15, 16 meet him. {{BIBLE:mat 25:7}} Then all those virgins arose, and made ready their lamps. {{BIBLE:mat 25:8}} The foolish 17 said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out. {{BIBLE:mat 25:9}} But those wise answered and said, Perhaps there will not be enough for us and you: but go ye to 18 the sellers, and buy for yourselves. {{BIBLE:mat 25:10}} And when they went away to buy, the bridegroom came; and those that were ready went in with him to the marriage feast: and 19 the door was shut. {{BIBLE:mat 25:11}} And at last those other virgins also came and said, Our Lord, 20 our Lord, open unto us. {{BIBLE:mat 25:12}} He answered and said unto them, Verily I say unto you, 21 I know you not. {{BIBLE:mat 25:13}} Watch then, for you know not that day nor that hour.

22 {{BIBLE:mat 25:14}} It is as a man, who went on a journey, and called his servants, and delivered unto 23 them his possessions. {{BIBLE:mat 25:15}} And unto one he gave five talents, and another two, and another 24 one; every one according to his strength; and went on his journey immediately. {{BIBLE:mat 25:16}} He [Arabic, p. 164] then that received the five talents went and traded with them, and gained 26 other five. {{BIBLE:mat 25:17}} And so also he of the two gained other two. {{BIBLE:mat 25:18}} But he that received 27 the one went and dug in the earth, and hid the money of his lord. {{BIBLE:mat 25:19}} And after a long time the lord of those servants came, and took from them the account. 28 {{BIBLE:mat 25:20}} And he that received five talents came near and brought other five, and said, My lord, you gave me five talents: lo, I have gained other five in addition to them. 29 {{BIBLE:mat 25:21}} His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant: over a little have 30 you been faithful, over much will I set you: enter into the joy of your lord. {{BIBLE:mat 25:22}} And he that had the two came near and said, My lord, you gave me two talents: lo, 31 other two have I gained in addition to them. {{BIBLE:mat 25:23}} His lord said unto him, Good, you faithful servant: over a little have you been faithful, over much will I set you: enter 32 into the joy of your lord. {{BIBLE:mat 25:24}} And he also that received the one talent came forward and said, My lord, I knew you that you are a severe man, who reaps where you 33 sow not, and gathers where you did not scatter: {{BIBLE:mat 25:25}} and so I was afraid, and 34 went away and hid your talent in the earth: lo, you have what is yours. {{BIBLE:mat 25:26}} His lord answered and said unto him, You wicked and slothful servant, you knew me 35 that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I did not scatter; {{BIBLE:mat 25:27}} it was incumbent on you to put my money to the bank, and then I should come and seek it with its 36 gains. {{BIBLE:mat 25:28}} Take now from him the talent, and give it to him that has ten talents. 37 {{BIBLE:mat 25:29}} Whosoever has shall be given, and he shall have more: but he that has not, even 38 [Arabic, p. 165] what he has shall be taken from him. {{BIBLE:mat 25:30}} And the unprofitable servant, put him forth into the outer darkness: there shall be the weeping and gnashing of teeth.

39, 40 {{BIBLE:luk 12:35}} Your loins shall be girded, and your lamps lit; {{BIBLE:luk 12:36}} and you shall be like the people that are looking for their lord, when he shall return from the feast; so that, when 41 he comes and knocks, they may at once open unto him. {{BIBLE:luk 12:37}} Blessed are those servants, whom their lord shall come and find attentive: verily I say unto you, that he will gird his waist, and make them sit down, and pass through them and serve 42 them. {{BIBLE:luk 12:38}} And if he come in the second watch, or the third, and find thus, blessed are those servants.

43 {{BIBLE:mat 25:31}} But when the Son of man comes in his glory, and all his pure angels with him, 44 then shall he sit on the throne of his glory: {{BIBLE:mat 25:32}} and he will gather before him all the nations, and separate them the one from the other, like the shepherd who separates 45 the sheep from the goats; {{BIBLE:mat 25:33}} and will set the sheep on his right, and the goats on his 46 left. {{BIBLE:mat 25:34}} Then shall the King say to those that are at his right, Come, you blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundations of the world: 47 {{BIBLE:mat 25:35}} I hungered, and you gave me to eat; and I thirsted, and you gave me to drink; and I 48 was a stranger, and you took me in; {{BIBLE:mat 25:36}} and I was naked, and you clothed me; and I 49 was sick, and you visited me; and I was in prison, and you cared for me. {{BIBLE:mat 25:37}} Then shall those righteous say unto him, Our Lord, when saw we you hungry, and fed you? 50 or thirsty, and gave you to drink? {{BIBLE:mat 25:38}} And when saw we you a stranger, and took 51 you in? Or naked, and clothed you? {{BIBLE:mat 25:39}} And when saw we you sick, or imprisoned, and 52 cared for you? {{BIBLE:mat 25:40}} The King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, What 53 [Arabic, p. 166] ye did to one of these my brethren, the little ones, you did unto me. {{BIBLE:mat 25:41}} Then shall he say unto those that are on his left also, Depart from me, you cursed, 54 into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his hosts: {{BIBLE:mat 25:42}} I hungered, and you fed me 55 not; and I thirsted, and you did not give me to drink; {{BIBLE:mat 25:43}} and I was a stranger, and you took me not in; and I was naked, and you clothed me not; and I was sick, and imprisoned, 56 and you visited me not. {{BIBLE:mat 25:44}} Then shall those also answer and say, Our Lord, when saw we you an hungred, or thirsty, or naked, or a stranger, or sick, or imprisoned, 57 and did not minister unto you? {{BIBLE:mat 25:45}} Then shall he answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, When ye did it not unto one of these little ones, you did it not 58 unto me also. {{BIBLE:mat 25:46}} And these shall go away into eternal punishment: but the righteous into eternal life.
